Describe a temporal span

Source: R/temporal.R
time_span.Rd

Elapsed spans use seconds (a day is 86400 seconds); calendar spans use local calendar arithmetic. Calendar month and year arithmetic clamps invalid dates to the final day of the month. Count spans count ordered observations. Numeric time indices are interpreted in seconds. Tsibble year-week, year-month and year-quarter indices use the first date of each period for elapsed and calendar arithmetic; source index columns are preserved.

Usage

time_span(
  n,
  unit = "seconds",
  type = "elapsed",
  ambiguous = "error",
  nonexistent = "error"
)

Arguments

n

Nonnegative span length. Calendar and count spans require integers.

unit

A time unit, or "observations" for a count span.

type

One of "elapsed", "calendar", or "count" (also accepted as "observations"). The default for unit = "observations" is "count".

ambiguous, nonexistent

Resolution passed to clock::add_days() for ambiguous or nonexistent local times; both default to "error".

Value

A temporal span specification.
